answer: No. The [[Desktop Sync]] page says the server SilverBullet Desktop syncs with "cannot live behind an auth proxy (other than SilverBullet's [[Authentication]])", because auth proxies "are not (yet) supported". Cloudflare Zero Trust is an auth proxy, so Desktop sync won't work through it. Browser access is different: `Authentication Proxy.md` covers running the server behind Cloudflare Zero Trust in a browser, if you exclude `/service_worker.js` and `/.client/*` from authentication.
